_comment: The inside of the guard tower, a SEPARATE model from the tower rock with the SAME origin (guard-room floor = y 0): drop it into the Tower node at identity next to tower_hollow.glb, whose cuts (tools/modelling/tower/tower_hollow_build.py) follow this lining. Built from tools/modelling/tower/tower_interior_build.py, which reads tower_new.blend every build (never writes it) to size the shaft. Doorway at the courtyard (y -36.4) facing +X (game bearing 0): the passage is the hollow rock's own cut, the interior draws a stone reveal round it; a stone stair spirals ccw up the wall (2.0 m clear tread, 0.25 rise, 0.35 going 0.5 m off the parapet, 2.5 m landings every ~90 deg, a landing chamber near the waist, slot windows, drips, 2.4 m headroom) arriving through a stairwell in the room floor -- the build log prints its bearings; the rock's room-floor collider is cut to it. One textured surface (painted HellRock atlas, byte-identical to the tower's), one UV set, no skin, no animation. TowerInteriorCollision rides in the .glb as a `-colonly` node built from the drawn faces themselves, with a smooth ramp under the treads (a 0.25 m riser is a wall to the capsule); Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` counts only what is drawn.
